purpose: Stage 4 claims classified by assurance layer. Categories are NOT merged.

legend.FORMALLY_SPECIFIED: defined as a Lean predicate/spec, not proven as a standalone theorem
legend.LEAN_RUNTIME_CONFORMANCE_VALIDATED: runtime verifier verdict matches Lean decide-oracle over a finite canonical vector corpus
legend.RUNTIME_TEST_VALIDATED: enforced and asserted by pytest tests/cli/
legend.REAL_EXECUTION_VALIDATED: observed on a real isolated Stage 4 mission run (abc_execution_dossier.json)
legend.ARCHITECTURAL_INVARIANT: holds by module structure / call graph, checked statically
legend.TCB_DEPENDENT: correctness rests on a Trusted Computing Base component (see tcb_and_limitations.json)

claims.claim: No machine descendant widens the human authorized scope (NoAuthorityAmplification)
Every authorized action is within the exact plan scope (ActionWithinMissionScope)
scopeLE is a preorder (reflexive + transitive)
An action witness binds exactly one EAH (ActionAuthorityBindsExactEAH)
Action base equals the current mission tip (ActionBaseEqualsCurrentMissionTip)
Mission action budget never exceeded
A revoked mission authority cannot authorize an action (RevokedMissionCannotAuthorizeAction)
A closed mission cannot authorize an action (ClosedMissionCannotAuthorizeAction)
Plan revision cannot expand authorized scope without a new HMA
Per-action authority material is distinct (PerActionAuthorityDistinct)
Derived scope is a subset of the human authorized scope (2nd central theorem)
16 of 17 invariant *Spec are machine-checked theorems, axiom-free
Central theorem #17 (every governed mutation has a valid human mission witness AND a valid KX witness) holds for the canonical A->B->C fixture and the single-operation V0 domain
HMA / DAAW / DMAE are NON_SOVEREIGN; none satisfies a KX decision or bypasses KX108_PRE
KX108_PRE is the only sovereign pre-execution decision and executes per action
A derived approval is never consumable on approved_by + structure + self-hash alone; every privileged consumer reloads and exact-binds the canonical DMAE artifact
A canonically committed HMA revocation and a governed mutation have a total serialized commit order (no mutation succeeds under a revocation committed-before)
claims.note: Fix B, Stage 4F; TCB: OS advisory lock semantics

claims.claim: One human mission authorization covers a whole fixed bounded plan; zero per-action human EAH approvals in Stage 4 mode
claims.boundary: O(1) for a fixed exact bounded plan only; NOT unrestricted autonomy

claims.claim: KX decisions stay O(N): each action gets an independent KX108_PRE and KX108_POST; no mission-level blanket KX authority
Restart/resume from disk with no in-memory authority dependency; prepared DAAW is reused with no divergent duplicate
claims.note: TCB: filesystem durability + JSON canonicalization + sha256

claims.claim: <= 1 governed target mutation per advance call; A+B+C never executed in one opaque call
Only KEEP advances mission_tip; canonical_base_sha immutable
Historical PER_ACTION_HUMAN_EAH mode unchanged; no silent Stage 4 activation; no Stage 4 -> Stage 3 auto-fallback
Lean runtime conformance over 17 semantic vectors + 11 scope pairs, 0 divergence
claims.boundary: finite canonical corpus, not universal refinement; op_expansion NOT_REPRESENTABLE (Lean Operation cardinality = 1)

claims.claim: sha256 / execution_authority_hash collision resistance
claims.note: Lean: CryptoInterface hypothesis fields; runtime: hashlib.sha256

claims.claim: Multi-operation (CREATE/DELETE/MOVE/RENAME) governed authority
Hard technical enforcement that Claude is transport-only
